title: data_items eval matches findings by file and line overlap
description: As a corpus reviewer, I want a data_items finding on the same file and overlapping lines as an annotation to count as a location match even when subject keys differ (rule id vs field name), so that recall is not zeroed by identity mismatch.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
Feature: data_items location-first identity

  Scenario: Overlapping lines match when keys differ
    Given a positive data_items case with subject.key data_item:phone
    And a finding key data_item:phone_number on the same file and overlapping lines
    When I score the eval cases
    Then the case is matched

  Scenario: components still require key equality
    Given a components case with subject.key asset:db
    And a finding key asset:other on overlapping lines
    When I score the eval cases
    Then the case is not matched
